Name: (AT) Facelift style pack for Drorie's Krobus Cows
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

Retexture of Drorie's adorable Krobus Cows to match the facelift style - includes two versions empty eyes and yellow eyes!

Let me know if there's any bugs or if you'd like me to add anything!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Alternative Textures mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder


[*]Go to Robin's shop and buy the Paint Bucket tool.


[*]When holding the paint bucket tool click on the krobus cows and choose the cow retexture!



[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]

Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece/mods?gameId=1303]Siamece [/url]﻿for the asset use permissions to allow the use of editing assets without permission (but with credit). in
order to add compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]﻿.

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
